title: It is no secret

lines.text: It is no secret what God can do,
It is no secret what God can do.

chords:
[Verse]
It is no [C]secret what God can [G]do,
What He's done for [F]others,
[G]He'll do for [C]you
With arms wide [C7]open,
He'll pardon [F]you,
It is no [C]secret what [G]God can [C]do.
lyrics:
[Verse]
It is no secret what God can do,
What He's done for others,
He'll do for you
With arms wide open,
He'll pardon you,
It is no secret what God can do.
